answer_1.quote: Text summarization is the process of distilling the most important information from a source to produce an abridged version for a particular user or task.

answer_2.quote: We examine whether these problems can be automatically detected by 5 widely-used metrics, including ROUGE and 4 faithfulness evaluation metrics for abstractive summarization (FactCC, DAE, QuestEval, BERTScore).

answer_4.quote: Four annotators, two of the authors (PhD students trained in NLP/CL) and two other CS undergraduate students (researchers in NLP/CL), conducted all annotations carefully in about 3 months.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators are asked to judge whether the summary has each of the five types of unfaithfulness via five yes or no questions and if yes, justify the choice by pointing out the unfaithful parts.
